title: Early return discards parsed cookies
detail: When a cookie string is provided, the function returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict immediately, skipping the parsing loop that follows. This means any valid cookies are lost.
note: Describes the planted negation: a cookie string that is given parses to nothing.

title: Unexpected kwargs forwarded to http.parse_cookie
detail: The function signature of `werkzeug.http.parse_cookie` does not accept a `cls` keyword argument (it was removed in this PR). Forwarding `**kwargs` can cause a TypeError if callers still pass `cls` or other deprecated arguments.

title: Incorrect file pointer check
detail: The condition skips processing when fp is not None, which is the opposite of the intended behaviour. This causes valid file objects to be ignored and may lead to missing data in uploads.

title: Breakpoint handling only when both horizontal and vertical breakpoints exist
detail: The original implementation applied breakpoints independently for horizontal and vertical sizes. After the change, _set_breakpoints is only called when both lists are non-empty, so if only horizontal or only vertical breakpoints are defined, no breakpoint classes are applied, breaking existing behaviour.
